messages.content: I'll run a SPARQL SELECT that finds Bianca Riario's mother using common DBpedia properties (dbo:mother, dbp:mother, dbo:parent, dbp:parent) and then finds that mother's father (maternal grandfather) using father/parent properties. The query returns the IRI(s) and English label(s) of the maternal grandfather(s).

messages.name: execute

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?maternalGrandfather ?maternalGrandfatherLabel WHERE {
  dbr:Bianca_Riario ?motherProp ?mother .
  FILTER (?motherProp IN (dbo:mother, dbp:mother, dbo:parent, dbp:parent))
  ?mother ?fatherProp ?maternalGrandfather .
  FILTER (?fatherProp IN (dbo:father, dbp:father, dbo:parent, dbp:parent))
  OPTIONAL { ?maternalGrandfather rdfs:label ?maternalGrandfatherLabel . FILTER(lang(?maternalGrandfatherLabel) = 'en') }
}

content.message: I'll run a SPARQL SELECT that finds Bianca Riario's mother using common DBpedia properties (dbo:mother, dbp:mother, dbo:parent, dbp:parent) and then finds that mother's father (maternal grandfather) using father/parent properties. The query returns the IRI(s) and English label(s) of the maternal grandfather(s).

tool_calls.name: execute

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?maternalGrandfather ?maternalGrandfatherLabel WHERE {
  dbr:Bianca_Riario ?motherProp ?mother .
  FILTER (?motherProp IN (dbo:mother, dbp:mother, dbo:parent, dbp:parent))
  ?mother ?fatherProp ?maternalGrandfather .
  FILTER (?fatherProp IN (dbo:father, dbp:father, dbo:parent, dbp:parent))
  OPTIONAL { ?maternalGrandfather rdfs:label ?maternalGrandfatherLabel . FILTER(lang(?maternalGrandfatherLabel) = 'en') }
}
